Headquartered in the United States, TP-Link Systems Inc. is a global provider of reliable networking devices and smart home products, consistently ranked as the world’s top provider of Wi-Fi devices. The company is committed to delivering innovative products that enhance people’s lives through faster, more reliable connectivity. With a commitment to excellence, TP-Link serves customers in over 170 countries and continues to grow its global footprint.
We believe technology changes the world for the better! At TP-Link Systems Inc, we are committed to crafting dependable, high-performance products to connect users worldwide with the wonders of technology.
Embracing professionalism, innovation, excellence, and simplicity, we aim to assist our clients in achieving remarkable global performance and enable consumers to enjoy a seamless, effortless lifestyle.
Overview
We are seeking a creative and trend-savvy
Social Media Content Specialist
to grow brand awareness, engagement, and community presence across Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts. This role will be responsible for executing day-to-day social media activities, managing content calendars, creating engaging short-form content, and identifying emerging trends that strengthen TP-Link's connection with consumers.
The ideal candidate combines strong content creation skills with a data-driven approach to social media marketing. They will develop and publish compelling social content, collaborate with creative teams and influencers, and capitalize on real-time trends to maximize reach and engagement. Success in this role requires hands-on experience producing short-form video content, deep knowledge of social platform best practices, and the ability to balance creative storytelling with measurable business results.
Responsibilities
1. Channel & Calendar Management
Execute Daily Publishing: Plan, schedule, and publish daily content across Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts, ensuring every channel remains active, on-brand, and consistently scheduled.
Content Calendar Strategy: Build and maintain an integrated social content calendar aligned with product launches, promotional campaigns, seasonal moments, and trending topics.
2. Content Creation & Production
Agile Content Creation: Shoot and edit native short-form video (Reels, Shorts) and photo content independently when quick turnaround or real-time trend capitalization is needed.
Creative Briefing & Asset Coordination: Draft clear creative briefs and collaborate with internal graphic designers, video editors, and copywriters to produce high-quality brand assets.
Budget & Production Management: Manage micro-budgets for creative production, freelance resources, or sponsored post boosts as required.
3. Trend Discovery & Creator Activation
Trend Spotting: Continuously monitor viral audio, formats, memes, and emerging social trends, pitching actionable ideas with a clear hypothesis on why they will perform.
Influencer & Creator Engagement: Identify relevant tech creators, reviewers, and lifestyle influencers worth activating for content collaborations, product seeding, or co-branded campaigns.
Requirements
Bachelor's degree required.
3+ Year of hands-on experience managing brand social media channels (consumer electronics, hardware, or DTC e-commerce background strongly preferred).
Production Skills: Proven ability to shoot, edit, and produce short-form video content using mobile editing tools (CapCut, Premiere Rush, or native platform editors).
Platform Mastery: Deep understanding of Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and Facebook formats, algorithms, and performance analytics.
Creative & Analytical Mindset: Ability to balance aesthetic storytelling with data-driven decision-making to optimize reach, impressions, and engagement rate"
Benefits
Salary range: $73,500 - $100,00 annually
Fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance (partial premium coverage for dependents)
Contributions to 401k funds
Bi-annual reviews, and annual pay increases
Health and wellness benefits, including free gym membership
Quarterly team-building events

About Us
HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with meaningful remote opportunities at U.S. and Canadian companies. We build globally distributed teams around people who take ownership, communicate clearly, and deliver at a high standard.
For this opportunity, you will support a direct-to-consumer subscription business where lifecycle marketing plays a central role in customer experience, retention, and long-term revenue.
About the Role
As an Email / Lifecycle Marketing Specialist, you will own hands-on execution across email, SMS, segmentation, retention, deliverability, and reporting. You will personally build and maintain Klaviyo campaigns, automations, and lifecycle flows while managing the connection between Klaviyo and Recharge.
This is an individual contributor role for someone who enjoys being close to the work. You will be expected to understand the strategy behind each campaign, but you will also be the person building, testing, troubleshooting, launching, and optimizing it.
Because the business operates on a subscription model, your work will directly influence churn reduction, repeat purchases, upgrades, winbacks, and customer lifetime value.
Working hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST.
Responsibilities
Own and continuously improve the Klaviyo flow architecture across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, winback, and other key lifecycle stages.
Build, test, schedule, and launch email campaigns independently while maintaining an accurate campaign calendar.
Develop customer segments that enable more relevant messaging, stronger personalization, and better lifecycle performance.
Build and execute SMS campaigns and automations as part of an integrated email and retention strategy.
Own retention initiatives including churn-save programs, winback campaigns, upgrade offers, subscription messaging, and other customer lifecycle experiments.
Manage and troubleshoot the Klaviyo and Recharge integration to ensure subscription and customer data flows accurately between platforms.
Monitor email deliverability, list health, sender performance, and engagement signals, and resolve issues before they negatively affect results.
Analyze lifecycle performance and translate campaign, flow, and customer data into clear reporting and actionable recommendations.
Design and run thoughtful tests across messaging, offers, segmentation, timing, and lifecycle journeys, explaining the rationale behind each test.
Troubleshoot execution issues independently using platform documentation, support resources, and AI tools before escalating routine problems.
Requirements
Must-Have:
3-6+ years of experience in lifecycle, retention, CRM, or email marketing, with flexibility on exact seniority for candidates with strong hands-on experience.
Deep, hands-on Klaviyo experience, including personally building campaigns, automations, flows, segments, and reporting.
DTC or e-commerce lifecycle marketing experience.
Experience designing and maintaining lifecycle flow architecture rather than only managing or reviewing other people's work.
Hands-on experience with customer segmentation, SMS marketing, email deliverability, and list health.
Experience executing retention programs such as churn-save initiatives, winbacks, subscription offers, upgrades, or similar lifecycle campaigns.
Ability to work independently, troubleshoot problems, follow detailed instructions accurately, and take ownership through completion.
Hands-on knowledge of the Klaviyo + Recharge integration and subscription data flows.
Nice to Have:
Strong experience with subscription-based e-commerce businesses.
Experience creating email assets in Canva, Photoshop, or AI-powered creative tools.
Experience developing lifecycle strategy and explaining the reasoning behind campaign, segmentation, testing, and automation decisions.
Familiarity with using AI tools to accelerate creative production, analysis, research, and troubleshooting.
